subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank with the synonym of the underlined word.

The film was a __funny__ adaption of an old classic. The ________ depiction was well received by the audience.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'**. i.e. **'Humorous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word is **"funny,"** meaning causing laughter or amusement (हास्यास्पद).
 
• The correct **synonym **is **"humorous," **meaning causing lighthearted laughter and amusement (हास्यप्रिय).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Humorous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **"Trendy" **means fashionable (फैशनेबल).
 
• Option 3:** "Nervous" **means anxious or tense (घबराया हुआ).
 
• Option 4:** "Tropical"** pertains to the tropics, the regions close to the Equator (उष्णकटिबंधीय).
